TOOLING BURST FL-5c — casts toward the camera: draw order + release clauses for the tip sockets (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; conductor R-C5-129 after FL-5b's sheet). task_id "FL-5c".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows FL-1a, FL-2c, FL-5, FL-5b and the new row "FL-5c — casts toward the camera" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json (the conductor applied the S/SW/W tip sockets: S [241,117], SW [329,137], W [228,118]; the rest unchanged), export/godot_import.py (G1 painted projectile: release, eruption, z ordering vs the Keeper/actors; the FL-1a release clauses), tests/test_godot_import.py (FireLaneHeadlessTests: the eight-direction release/rear/body-clearance clauses; the FL-5 socket audit test), tests/test_vfx_picker.py, runs/C-5/cliffside_v41/ (staged, READ ONLY), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

RULING TO IMPLEMENT: the release socket IS the staff tip in every direction (data already applied). For casts toward the camera (S, SW, SE — the raised tip sits ABOVE the figure), the bolt erupts from the tip and flies toward the camera ACROSS the body: (1) the projectile must draw IN FRONT of the actor for its first 10 frames after release (z above the Keeper / actors layer; then normal y-sort), for every direction whose facing has a +y component; (2) the FL-1a clauses change: `(release − origin)·facing > 0` becomes `socket == the cell's release socket` (the tip) with the dot allowed down to −0.7 BH; `head_centre_in_body` is dropped for S/SW/SE (the head passes over the body by design) and kept for the others; the capsule ignores the caster (already); (3) the FL-5 socket-audit test is re-encoded to assert the eight sockets EQUAL sockets_v2.json's rows (the data is the law; the ferrule/facing rules retire as instruments — say so in the docstring).
Trace clauses (probe_events + probe_cast_dir from (3760,640), eight directions): release position = the cell socket in world space (±2 px) for all eight; for S/SW/SE the projectile's z is above the Keeper's for frames 0–10 and the head is drawn (visible) on every one of those frames; E still contacts the shield first (body 3); N/NE/NW/W range-impact at the range point; no direction spawns behind the caster's back relative to the facing by more than 0.7 BH.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-5c/acceptance.json): the eight-direction table (socket world pos, first-10-frame z relation, first contact/expiry); kits and primitives byte-identical (18); catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED; byte locks by the FL-1b rule if the emitted scene changes.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit, any spec, sockets_v2.json (applied by the conductor), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-5c/; fixtures/ only for byte locks. No Godot GUI. No deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-5c/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-5c"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
